items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I don't remember about him, but... Oh, that's way before your time.

ctx.x: A wine joint. Doublehead. They used to call him doublehead.
You remember Captain William Peterson, don't you? That's him.
I don't remember about him, but...
